name: Brawler
description: Your golem is built with inbuilt weapons and protection, making it tough and dangerous. Its blunt arms cannot hold delicate objects or manipulate things.

name: Soldier
description: Your golem is built as a humanoid soldier. It’s versatile and capable of holding weapons and shields in its arms.
skills: Two of Athletics, Brawling, Intimidation and Stealth
weapons: Simple weapons, shields and one weapon group

name: Quadruped
description: Your golem is built as a quadruped form, resembling an animal of some sort. It cannot pick up objects or interact with things.
naturalWeaponDesc: (PHY + trained), 1d8 + PHY bludgeoning damage. Deadly d6.

name: Scout
description: Your golem is built as a nimble scout, trading resistance for speed and dexterity.
featureOneDesc: Ignores difficult terrain and treats greater difficult terrain as difficult terrain
skills: Two of Acrobatics, Performance, Sleight of hand or Stealth
weapons: Simple weapons and one weapon group
